_comment: One Tamil-only Nalam agent. Replace the HTTPS placeholders and secret before importing into Bolna. The ASR, LLM, and TTS providers below are selected from Bolna's preferred bundled model set.

tamil.name: Nalam Tamil Medication Adherence Assistant
tamil.description: Tamil-only medication adherence calls for consented elderly patients.
tamil.first_message: வணக்கம். நான் நலம் உதவியாளர் பேசுகிறேன். {patient_name} அவர்களுடன் பேசுகிறேனா? எப்படி இருக்கிறீர்கள்?

tools.name: report_adherence
tools.description: Call exactly once after the conversation ends. Send only the validated medication outcome collected from the intended patient.

notes.description: Short patient-reported symptom or reason, without diagnosis

deployment_notes.backend_url: Use a public HTTPS backend URL; Bolna cannot reach localhost.
deployment_notes.webhook_secret: Set the same high-entropy BOLNA_WEBHOOK_SECRET in the backend and the Bolna custom-tool header.
deployment_notes.agent_id_env: Set the imported Tamil agent ID as BOLNA_AGENT_ID_TAMIL.
import_steps: 1. Deploy the backend or expose it through a secure HTTPS tunnel.
3. Import the Tamil agent and verify its published webhook/tool URLs.
4. Set BOLNA_API_KEY and BOLNA_AGENT_ID_TAMIL in the backend environment.
5. Test with a consented synthetic Tamil patient before any real patient data.
